projects.title: Vision Transformer (ViT) & Attention Classification
projects.summary: Implementation and benchmarking of a patch-based Vision Transformer for multi-class visual recognition with custom multi-head self-attention layers.
highlights: Constructed patch projection and learnable 1D position embeddings from scratch
Trained with AdamW optimizer, cosine annealing schedule, and gradient clipping
Conducted ablation study comparing standard CNN baselines vs self-attention heads
Logged real-time validation metrics and attention roll-out maps

projects.title: Domain-Adapted Transformer for Clinical & Semantic Text
projects.summary: Fine-tuned language model leveraging Hugging Face Transformers for domain-specific named entity recognition and classification with attention masking.
highlights: Implemented customized tokenization with subword byte-pair encoding
Fine-tuned pre-trained Transformer weights using mixed-precision FP16 training
Exposed high-throughput REST inference endpoint serving predictions under 35ms
Built automated evaluation pipeline tracking F1, Precision, and Recall scores

metrics.f1Score: Evaluated on Standard Domain Test Split

projects.title: Predictive Analytics & Feature Engineering Engine
projects.summary: End-to-end data science pipeline conducting automated exploratory data analysis, outlier remediation, multivariate hypothesis testing, and gradient-boosted ensemble modeling.
highlights: Engineered robust feature pipelines handling skewed tabular distributions and missing data
Applied Bayesian hyperparameter optimization with cross-validated grid search
Generated SHAP (Shapley Additive Explanations) summary plots for model interpretability
Documented reproducible Jupyter notebook workflows and statistical conclusions

projects.title: Edge Computer Vision & Real-Time Object Tracking
projects.summary: High-framerate object detection and centroid tracking system optimized for live video streams with dynamic bounding box filtering.
highlights: Optimized bounding box inference achieving 45+ FPS on standard hardware
Built multi-object centroid tracking algorithm maintaining identity over occlusion
Designed real-time telemetry HUD displaying object count, confidence, and speed
Packaged complete inference environment inside portable Docker container
